description: This Java source file defines the ContentPermissionServices class, which provides services related to permission checks on Content entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for checking content permissions and associations between content items, utilizing various permission and entity validation mechanisms.

classes.name: ContentPermissionServices
classes.description: Provides static methods to perform permission checks related to Content entities, including permission validation for content operations and relationships.

methods.name: checkContentPermission
methods.description: Checks whether a user has permission to perform specified operations on a Content entity, taking into account purposes, roles, and permissions, with options to display detailed pass/fail conditions.

methods.name: checkAssocPermission
methods.description: Verifies if a user has permission to establish or check associations between two Content entities, based on permissions on links like CONTENT_LINK_FROM and CONTENT_LINK_TO.
